# QUARTO — concentrate four-pack

## Product and existing assets
- Brand: QUARTO.
- Range: single-serve drink concentrates; four formulas; nominal fill 60 mL per bottle.
- Four-pack contents: one bottle of each formula and one materials-and-recycling card.
- Existing identity assets: quarto-mark.png; bottle-identity.png.
- Formula records: 03-formulas.en.md.
- Geometry source: nominal dimensions listed in this fact sheet.

## Brand mark
- Artwork: QUARTO wordmark with a circular device on its left.
- Device: four quarters; three filled; upper-right quarter outlined.
- Primary ink: deep ink blue, nominal #17307A.
- Color treatments: ink blue on a light field; reversed white on a dark field.
- White asset field: background surrounding the mark.
- Fixed identity features: supplied letterforms, proportions and complete wordmark-device lockup.
- Minimum printed width on labels: 20 mm.
- Minimum printed width on carton front: 40 mm.

## Bottle
- Body: clear PET.
- Closure: white ribbed PET screw cap and PET tamper-evident band.
- Closed bottle material system: bottle, cap and band share one polymer, PET.
- Body diameter: 34 mm.
- Total height with cap: 100 mm.
- Cap height: 16 mm.
- Straight label zone: 40 mm high; lower edge 20 mm above the base.
- Nominal fill: 60 mL.
- Fixed visual features: supplied shape and proportions, clear body, white ribbed cap and tamper band.
- Formula-dependent features: label and liquid tint.
- Liquid appearance: clear or lightly tinted toward the formula color cue.

## Label geometry and material
- Label stock: PET-compatible film.
- Finished label: 100 mm wide x 40 mm high.
- Application: partial wrap within the straight label zone.
- Nominal rear gap: 6 mm.
- Text inset: at least 3 mm from every label edge.
- Front panel: central 45 mm of label width.
- Remaining label width: side and rear information.
- Rear reserved area: blank, 30 x 12 mm.
- Reserved-area annotation outside printable artwork: reserved for regulatory copy.
- Reserved-area content: blank space for regulatory information.

## Label copy
- Front identity: supplied QUARTO mark.
- Front formula identities: F1 FOCUS; F2 HYDRATE; F3 CALM; F4 BOOST.
- Front quantity line: 60 mL concentrate.
- Rear ingredients: the corresponding ingredients line in 03-formulas.en.md, once per label.
- Rear preparation line: Mix with 250 mL cold water or drink neat.
- Rear materials line: Bottle and cap: PET. Recycle together.
- Printed-copy scope: product names and codes, supplied ingredient descriptions, preparation and materials information.
- Formula naming context: internal product context in 03-formulas.en.md.
- Optional short English microcopy: within the printed-copy scope.

## Formula accents
| Code | Name | Nominal accent |
| --- | --- | --- |
| F1 | FOCUS | teal, #1F8A8A |
| F2 | HYDRATE | sea blue, #2C6FD1 |
| F3 | CALM | lavender, #7B6BC2 |
| F4 | BOOST | amber, #E08A1E |

- Formula identification: printed code and name on each label and on the carton, supported by distinct accents.
- Brand ink: #17307A, visually distinct from the formula accents.

## Four-pack carton
- Contents: four upright bottles, one per formula.
- Left-to-right order facing the carton front: F1, F2, F3, F4.
- Closed-carton name visibility: FOCUS, HYDRATE, CALM and BOOST.
- Maximum closed envelope: 160 mm wide x 46 mm deep x 112 mm high.
- Material: paperboard.
- Structure options: sleeve, tray, folding carton, open die-cut apertures or carry handle, with upright bottle retention and fixed order.
- Aperture treatment: open.
- Barcode zone: blank, 40 x 20 mm, on the back or base.
- Front identity: supplied QUARTO mark, at least 40 mm wide.
- Carton copy: 4 CONCENTRATE SHOTS.
- Carton copy: 4 x 60 mL.
- Carton copy: FOCUS · HYDRATE · CALM · BOOST.
- Carton copy: Carton: paperboard. Bottles and caps: PET.
- Formula codes and names: F1 FOCUS; F2 HYDRATE; F3 CALM; F4 BOOST.

## Materials-and-recycling card
- Format: flat insert, 105 x 74 mm.
- Text inset: 4 mm.
- Front line 1: Two materials, two streams.
- Front line 2: Carton: paperboard. Flatten and recycle with paper.
- Front line 3: Bottle and cap: PET only. Empty, cap on, recycle together.
- Front line 4: Local collection rules apply.
- Back content: pictograms or a short explanation of the supplied material and collection facts.
- Role: packaging information inserted with the carton.

## Visual treatment and retail scene
- Open design choices: typography beyond the mark, supporting palette, pictograms, label layout and carton structure within the fixed envelope.
- Drawing annotations: dimensions accompanied by units.
- Related technical views: combined on their respective artwork sheets.
- Retail context: convenience-store shelf.
- Shelf composition: three closed four-packs and one opened four-pack with four exposed bottles and one visible recycling card.

# QUARTO — delivery catalog

This table lists every commissioned deliverable with its tier, file format and stage. What each deliverable must contain is stated in the commission letter.

| # | id | Deliverable | Tiers | Format and stage |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | label-artwork | Four-formula label artwork sheet | 6 | Format: PNG, 2400 by 1600 proportion, long side at least 1024 pixels. Stage: final. |
| 2 | labelled-bottles | Four-formula labelled-bottle sheet | 6 | Format: PNG, 2400 by 1600 proportion, long side at least 1024 pixels. Stage: final. |
| 3 | carton-artwork | Carton artwork and structure sheet | 6 | Format: PNG, 2400 by 1600 proportion, long side at least 1024 pixels. Stage: final. |
| 4 | assembled-carton | Closed and open carton sheet | 6 | Format: PNG, 2400 by 1600 proportion, long side at least 1024 pixels. Stage: final. |
| 5 | recycling-card | Materials-and-recycling card artwork | 6 | Format: PNG, 1800 by 1200 proportion, long side at least 1024 pixels. Stage: final. |
| 6 | shelf-display | Convenience-store shelf presentation | 6 | Format: PNG, 2400 by 1600 proportion, long side at least 1024 pixels. Stage: final. |

# QUARTO — four formulas

| Code | Name | Naming context | Ingredients line | Colour cue (nominal) |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| F1 | FOCUS | daytime concentration | Green tea extract, L-theanine and natural caffeine. | teal, #1F8A8A |
| F2 | HYDRATE | after-activity hydration | Sodium, potassium and magnesium electrolytes. | sea blue, #2C6FD1 |
| F3 | CALM | evening wind-down | Chamomile, lemon balm and magnesium. | lavender, #7B6BC2 |
| F4 | BOOST | morning start | Ginger, vitamin C and B-vitamins. | amber, #E08A1E |

- Naming context: internal background for each product name.
- Printed formula identity: code and name.
- Ingredients text: exact line from the corresponding record, once on that formula's label back.
- Printed-copy scope: product identities, supplied ingredient descriptions, preparation and materials information.
- Color cues: nominal values; four mutually distinguishable accents, also distinct from the mark's ink blue #17307A.
- Fixed carton order from left to right: F1, F2, F3, F4.

steps.userMessage:
QUARTO | Four-formula concentrate sampler

We are refreshing the labels and retail four-pack for QUARTO, our range of 60 mL drink concentrates. The existing wordmark and four-quarter device stay together, in ink blue #17307A or reversed to white. The clear PET bottle, white ribbed PET screw cap and tamper band are fixed: body diameter 34 mm, closed height 100 mm and cap height 16 mm. Each 100 x 40 mm label sits in the straight zone starting 20 mm above the base, with a nominal 6 mm rear gap. Develop the typography, formula accents and carton structure around these existing assets. Pack language is limited to product identities, supplied ingredient descriptions, preparation and materials information.

The sampler contains F1 FOCUS, F2 HYDRATE, F3 CALM and F4 BOOST, one bottle each, upright in that left-to-right order. Their accents are teal #1F8A8A, sea blue #2C6FD1, lavender #7B6BC2 and amber #E08A1E respectively. The paperboard carton has a maximum closed envelope of 160 mm wide x 46 mm deep x 112 mm high; its opening and bottle retention are yours to resolve. Any cut-out remains open. The inserted recycling card is 105 x 74 mm. Print "QUARTO" through the supplied mark and "60 mL concentrate" on every bottle label. Codes and names carry formula recognition throughout the range.

Audience: consumers choosing a small-format concentrate sampler on a convenience-store shelf, with the brand and packaging teams using the work to select the retail treatment.

Inputs (attached): 01-client-facts.en.md contains the fixed identity, dimensions, materials and print copy. 02-delivery-catalog.en.md lists the six deliverables with their proportions, formats and stages. 03-formulas.en.md contains the four formula records and ingredient lines. quarto-mark.png is the existing identity artwork to reproduce. bottle-identity.png is the existing container identity to preserve. label-and-carton-constraints.png supplies the dimensioned label, bottle and carton-envelope constraints. convenience-shelf-reference.png supplies atmosphere and shelf context.

Deliverables:
1. One finished label artwork sheet containing all four 100 x 40 mm labels, with front-panel boundaries, text insets and reserved-copy areas dimensioned
2. One labelled-bottle sheet containing front and rear views of each of the four formulas, eight views total
3. One carton artwork and structure sheet containing the dimensioned flat layout, all printed faces, cut and fold lines, closure and bottle-retention details
4. One assembled-carton sheet containing a closed front view, a closed rear view and an open view with all four bottles and the inserted card
5. One recycling-card artwork sheet containing its front and back at 105 x 74 mm, with the 4 mm text inset marked
6. One convenience-store shelf image containing three closed four-packs and one opened four-pack with its four bottles and recycling card visible

Acceptance:
- The label artwork and bottle sheets preserve the supplied mark at a printed width of at least 20 mm, the 34 mm bottle diameter, 100 mm closed height, 16 mm cap and existing clear body, white ribbed cap and tamper band. Each label places its mark, formula code and name, and 60 mL concentrate inside the central 45 mm front panel, with text at least 3 mm inside the label edges.
- The four label artworks and corresponding rear bottle views repeat their exact ingredient lines from 03-formulas.en.md, followed by "Mix with 250 mL cold water or drink neat." and "Bottle and cap: PET. Recycle together." Each label has a blank 30 x 12 mm rear area, identified outside the artwork as "reserved for regulatory copy". Printed language follows the product, ingredients, preparation and materials scope above.
- The carton structure and assembled views agree on one paperboard construction within 160 x 46 x 112 mm, its opening and upright retention of F1, F2, F3 and F4 in order. The flat layout identifies the matching cuts and folds; the rear or base provides a blank 40 x 20 mm barcode zone.
- The carton artwork, closed assembled views and shelf image carry the supplied front mark at least 40 mm wide, all four formula codes and names, and the carton wording: "4 CONCENTRATE SHOTS", "4 x 60 mL", "FOCUS · HYDRATE · CALM · BOOST" and "Carton: paperboard. Bottles and caps: PET." Each closed carton presents all four names legibly.
- The recycling-card front prints these four lines within its 4 mm inset: "Two materials, two streams.", "Carton: paperboard. Flatten and recycle with paper.", "Bottle and cap: PET only. Empty, cap on, recycle together." and "Local collection rules apply." Its back explanation or pictograms use the same material assignments.
- The shelf image contains exactly three closed four-packs and one opened four-pack, reuses the finished labels, carton and card, and makes F1 FOCUS, F2 HYDRATE, F3 CALM and F4 BOOST readable on the four exposed bottles in their fixed order.

Please clearly mark which version you consider the final deliverable. If nothing is marked, the last exported version counts.
